mt5.description: Basic Attention Token vs US Dollar

narrative_engine.thesis: trend down regime (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -13.72 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP), but price sits 2.45σ from the Day VWAP — chasing here pays no edge. Working limit order at the trend-side band 0.07414-0.07471; the offer is earned when footprint absorption or a strong divergence prints at the zone.

plan.triggerRule: limit fill at the zone + bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap)
vetoes: chase guard: > 2.0σ VWAP extension — wait for the pullback

athena_oracle.verdict: Neutral equilibrium 46/100 — trend broken, bid-wall floor, funding still cool

basis.coinbaseReason: Coinbase premium tracked for BTC/ETH/SOL only

notes: taker buyVolUsd/sellVolUsd = Binance base-asset taker volume converted at the perp last price
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
